en:
Channel a shield of void energies upon an ally, causing both you and them to absorb ${$520346m1+$520346ppl1+$bh*1+$AP*.25} damage, stacking $520346u times, every $t1 sec for $d.

At the end of the duration, if the shield holds, you teleport to them.

While channeling you are immune to stuns and silences. Not usable on yourself.
